Keyboard Shortcuts

  • Ctrl+N: New Project.
  • Ctrl+O: Open Project.
  • Ctrl+S: Save.
  • Ctrl+Shift+S: Save As.
  • Ctrl+I: Import Media.
  • Ctrl+Up: Move Item Earlier.
  • Ctrl+Down: Move Item Later.
  • Alt+Enter: Item Properties.
  • Delete: Remove Item.
  • Ctrl+P: Preview from Selected Item.
  • Escape: Stop or close a dialog.
  • I: Set In point at the playhead.
  • O: Set Out point at the playhead.
  • Alt+Left or Alt+Right: Nudge the playhead by 0.001 second.
  • Ctrl+G: Enter an exact playhead time using Hours, Minutes, Seconds, and Milliseconds.
  • Ctrl+K: Split the selected item at the playhead without changing the source file.

Testing Guide

Reading the workspace: Leave the JAWS Virtual Cursor on.

Selecting project items: With the Virtual Cursor on, navigate to Project Items and position JAWS inside the list box. Then press Insert+Z to turn the Virtual Cursor off. Use plain Up Arrow and Down Arrow to select different items.

Rearranging project items: With focus inside Project Items and the Virtual Cursor off, use Ctrl+Up Arrow and Ctrl+Down Arrow. These move the selected item; they do not select another item.

Using the playhead: Position JAWS on the Playhead slider and turn the Virtual Cursor off. Use Arrow keys to move it. Alt+Left Arrow and Alt+Right Arrow move by one millisecond.

Setting edit points: With the Virtual Cursor off, press I for the In point or O for the Out point. Ctrl+G opens human-readable exact-time fields. Ctrl+K splits at the playhead.

Returning to reading: Press Insert+Z to turn the Virtual Cursor on again.

Native Open and Save dialogs: Virtual Cursor settings do not apply inside Windows file dialogs.

This build previews and trims one selected item at a time. It does not yet play or export the complete project.
